description: Start a self-serve signup for SyncPersonalized (Amazon Custom and Handmade personalization into ShipStation or Veeqo) or TokSync (TikTok Shop orders into Amazon MCF or ShipStation), when your person asked you to sign them up. DataAutomation emails the person one link; they click it, name the account, and connect Amazon, TikTok Shop, ShipStation, or Veeqo themselves in about 2 minutes. You never handle passwords or API keys, and nothing is charged now. If the email already has an account, the person gets a login link instead. Returns ok, status email_sent, and next_step.

agent.description: Who is asking; shown to the person in the email

app.description: syncpersonalized (ShipStation or Veeqo), syncpersonalized-veeqo, or toksync

email.description: The person's own work email. The setup link goes here

person_consented.description: True only if the person asked you to start this signup for them

platform.description: Where orders go. SyncPersonalized: shipstation (default) or veeqo. TokSync: amazon (Amazon MCF, default) or shipstation

name: start_app_signup
title: Start an app signup for your person
